subject: Invoice delivery governance: portal primary + one-time token / email fallback
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ap@acme-corp.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice delivery and AP access constraints

Hi Diego —

Quick context: our AP team (invoices@acme-corp.com) would like to receive invoices via your portal long-term, but they are blocked from self-enrolling because of our company's SSO provisioning window (IT can only add third-party logins on the 1st of the month). For November and December we need an interim arrangement so payments are not delayed.

Requests:
- Can Redwood make the portal the canonical delivery channel, but send email PDF copies to invoices@acme-corp.com until our SSO is active?
- We also need a VAT certificate on file for Acme EU entity (if you have a VAT proof PDF).
- If portal enrollment is the blocker, would a one-time tokenized access link work for the AP team to set up their account without full SSO provisioning?

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful; we need to confirm the path by EOD PST so our payment run next week can proceed.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Accounts Payable Manager
Acme Corp
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <ap@acme-corp.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and AP access constraints

Thanks Ellen — and good to know the SSO timing. We can support a few options; I want to surface tradeoffs so we pick one cleanly:

Options (short):
1) Portal primary + email copy: Redwood marks portal as canonical, but we will send a PDF copy to invoices@acme-corp.com until enrollment completes. Low friction, manual copy flag.
2) One-time tokenized portal enrollment: we generate a single-use secure token that gives AP enrollment access without SSO — token expiry configurable (recommend 7 days). Portal becomes primary immediately.
3) Direct PDF push / signed PDF via email (signed by billing entity) with SFTP as fallback for high-volume partners.

Questions for Redwood billing flow:
- Who should originate the invoice (US centralized payer vs Acme EU entity)? That affects VAT line items and remit instructions.
- Any constraints on sending PDF copies to invoices@acme-corp.com (security / legal)?

I attached a sample invoice PDF and a sample XML payload for bookkeeping (ACME_invoice_20251101.pdf, sample_invoice_xml.xml).

Kimberly / Marissa — can you weigh in on issuer entity and whether we can enable tokenized enrollment for this customer? If token is OK, we can issue it today and mark the portal authoritative immediately.

- Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Ellen Park <ap@acme-corp.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and AP access constraints

+1 on option #2 (one-time tokenized enrollment) as default. Quick notes:

- Token behavior: set expiry to 7 days, single-use, and require email confirmation from invoices@acme-corp.com. That avoids creating a permanent account without SSO.
- Email copies: we will send PDF copies to invoices@acme-corp.com while token is active and for one subsequent cycle as confirmation (configurable).
- VAT evidence: we have Acme EU VAT certificate on file; attaching portal-enroll-checklist.xlsx to indicate the evidence we will push to their profile.
- Issuer entity: Marissa's team should issue the invoice from Redwood US (single remit) for November — simpler for collections. If Acme needs EU invoicing for VAT recoverability, we can reissue via the EU entity once their procurement signals required VAT treatment.

I will coordinate the enrollment token generation with Connor and set the HubSpot deal note. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-DEAL-9876

Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Ellen Park <ap@acme-corp.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and AP access constraints

Thanks — plan below and short MAP so Acme and Redwood are aligned. I attached a draft MAP (MAP_ACME_portal_rollout.docx).

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Today (24 Nov): Kimberly to generate one-time portal token for invoices@acme-corp.com (expiry 7 days). Connor to capture token issuance in HubSpot.
- Tomorrow (25 Nov): Redwood sends token + portal-enroll-checklist.xlsx to Ellen; concurrently send PDF copy of November invoice to invoices@acme-corp.com (ACME_invoice_20251101.pdf).
- By 1 Dec: Acme confirms SSO provisioning window; if SSO still blocked, Redwood will reissue invoice from EU entity with VAT lines (if requested).
- Ongoing: Marissa to own issuer decision for any reissue and to keep AP and Customer Success looped for confirmations.

Attachments included: sample_invoice_xml.xml (for AP XML ingestion sample) and the MAP doc.

If no objections, Diego can send a short confirmation to Ellen and we’ll generate the token.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference
